positive: Straight-on cross-polarized material scan, uniform diffuse illumination. This is a texture for a game mesh, every pixel is the same surface, edge to edge, no object outline, no scene or cast shadow. An eight-centimetre square macro scan cut from the undisturbed middle of a Japanese bathhouse noren, deep aubergine purple, plain-weave indigo-red dyed medium weight cotton. Horizontal weft and vertical warp threads cross evenly, thread-level muted variation and a few pale slubs. Flat textile laid on scanner, no lettering, no seams, no folds, no gesture of lighting. Purple rather than bright pink.
